desc: Implement full program: parse H,W,X,P,Q and grid, convert P,Q to 0-indexed, set current = S[P][Q], mark start absorbed, seed min-heap with in-grid unabsorbed orthogonal neighbors.

Run the greedy loop: pop minimum-strength boundary cell (skip already absorbed via visited flag); if strength * X < current, absorb (add to current, mark absorbed, push unabsorbed in-grid neighbors); otherwise break.
Validate against samples (expect 28, 5, 1343), including edge cases H=W=1 (empty heap) and the strict inequality current > X*strength (break when equal).
Confirm termination/correctness: absorbing only increases strength and expands reachability, so min-heap closure gives the maximum; ensure X*strength uses Python big ints to avoid overflow.
